SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.GasStationID)

INNER JOIN StationSegment AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Country = 'SVK'
